title: Kinematic analysis of the Minispiral (Paumard+, 2004): the Northern Arm model's maps

evidence.locator: ReadMe, fig7b.fit: the line-of-sight distance from the plane that holds the central mass (Sgr A*), in equivalent milliarcseconds on the sky, positive where the structure is farther from the observer than the central mass. The model fixes a mass of 3 million Suns and a distance of 8 kpc; the pixel is 0.353 arcsec and Sgr A* is at pixel (59.2538, 38.9849), counted from 0 at the lower left.

statements.text: Paumard, Maillard & Morris (2004), A&A 426, 81; CDS catalogue J/A+A/426/81
